physiological_equivalent_description: Superior sagittal sinus pressure, the downstream boundary for cerebral venous outflow. Elevated in venous sinus stenosis and IIH. STREAMED AS A NEGATIVE CONTROL: it is the one parameter that stayed inside its healthy band in all four recordings, so a pipeline that reports it as pathological has a bug rather than a finding.
caveat: No healthy controls exist in this dataset - all four recordings are ICU patients. Healthy bounds are from literature, not from a control group measured with this pipeline.
